items.title: Trump describes Russian missiles and drones entering Poland as accidental
items.summary: US President Donald Trump told Fox News that Vladimir Putin had accidentally sent several drones and missiles into Poland. His characterization follows Polish reports of two missiles and a drone falling on Polish territory during Russia's overnight attack on Ukraine.

items.title: Polish general says Swedish pilots could not identify suspected Russian missile
items.summary: Polish Lieutenant General Nowak said Swedish Gripen pilots operating under NATO command attempted to intercept an object believed to be a Russian Kh-101 missile. One pilot could not visually or electronically identify it because of difficult weather conditions, he said.

items.title: Dutch embassy in Kyiv reportedly damaged; Russian diplomat urges evacuation
items.summary: The Dutch foreign minister reported minor damage to the Netherlands' embassy in Kyiv after a projectile fell nearby. Russian ambassador Vladimir Tarabrin urged the Dutch government to take Moscow's recommendation to leave Kyiv seriously, while saying Russia would continue strikes against Ukrainian military-related targets.
